verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a bare 'Web Scraping & Search' feature heading, which suggests the agent can pull content from live pages. Nothing shows it driving a real browser to navigate, log in or click on the user's behalf. MCP compatibility and custom agent skills could in principle extend it this way, but no browser-automation use is documented. Missing for 10: interactive browser control (navigation, clicking, form/login handling), any documentation of how scraping works, and hands-on corroboration.
